title: Tomatoes Stuffed with Herbs, Olives and Pine Nuts
subtitle: with Israeli couscous
description: Baked tomatoes filled with toasted Israeli couscous, black olives, pine nuts and a mix of fresh herbs.

steps.text: Cut the tops off the tomatoes and keep them aside. Scoop out the insides and discard.
Heat olive oil in a pot, add the pine nuts and brown lightly. Add the Israeli couscous, fry for a few seconds and continue cooking according to the packet instructions.
Add the pitted, roughly chopped olives, the chopped herbs, garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper to the cooked couscous and mix.
Fill each tomato with 2 tablespoons of filling, put the tomato cap on top and arrange tightly in an ovenproof dish with a little water.
Bake for about 40 minutes, until the tomatoes are soft and their skins wrinkle. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.
